status: PROPOSAL ONLY - 提议性方案 / shared foundational subject (proposal four)
status_note: This is the common geometric basis of proposals one to three, split out as its own subject as directed. It authorizes nothing, decides nothing, deploys nothing, asserts no physical effect and uses no data.
question: Which geometric quantities are COMMON to every proposal of this programme - the spot floor, the etendue ceiling, the usable fraction, the pattern scale, the symmetry constraints, the work-region and work-time calculus, and the ablation-level task assignment - and can each be stated once, exactly, with its derived status separated from the declarations it rests on?
level: Bounded external exact calibration of a shared geometric basis. No physical claim, no magnitude for any physical effect, no forecast, no data.

corrects.note: The previous run's usable-fraction bound pairs the Earth's angular RADIUS with the Sun's angular DIAMETER. The foundation states the pairings explicitly so that the mismatch cannot recur.
pairing_rules: An angular radius is paired only with an angular radius, and an angular diameter only with an angular diameter.
Occulted area fraction at a platform is (theta_earth / theta_sun)^2 with LIKE paired with LIKE.
A penumbra DIAMETER is D + theta_sun(full angular size) * L, so the spot floor uses the full angular size.

At the second Lagrange point the corrected occulted fraction is about 0.851 and the usable fraction about 0.149, replacing the superseded 0.787; the frozen payload of the earlier run keeps its digest and this correction lives in note 0240 and here.

shared_items.spot_floor: theta_sun * L at every declared distance, with the penumbra diameter form stated beside it.
shared_items.etendue_ceiling: B * lambda^2 per mode, which forces power into free space and keeps fibres for phase and coherence only.
shared_items.usable_fraction: One minus the corrected occulted fraction, per platform, with the pairing rule above.
shared_items.pattern_scale: The usable light-dark geometry sits near theta_sun * L; finer structure is washed out by the extended source and coarser interference structure needs apertures below the coherence length.
shared_items.symmetry_constraints: Which point groups a constellation can realise, and which of them lie inside the rotation subgroup of the relevant spacetime symmetry group; the declared reading is that a polyhedral point group is a subgroup of SO(3) and hence of the Lorentz group's rotation part, with the time direction entering as a declared schedule invariant under the corresponding time translations.
shared_items.work_region_and_time_calculus: Given a constellation, which regions are addressable, at which times, with which duty cycle, and subject to which geometric floor; regions and times must be computed in advance, not chosen in flight.
shared_items.ablation_level_assignment: Tasks are assigned to declared energy LEVELS matched to the ablation levels of the target medium, rather than to individual platforms.

declared_obligations.high_safety: Declared obligation with a falsifiable counterpart.
declared_obligations.topology_preserved: The overall topology must not be broken; declared obligation with a falsifiable counterpart.
declared_obligations.human_impact_controllable_and_small: Declared obligation with a falsifiable counterpart.
declared_obligations.error_tolerated_and_learned: Declared obligation: a bounded, declared error is tolerated and learned from, so that learning enters from stage one.
declared_obligations.no_magnitude: No magnitude, sign or timing is asserted for any physical quantity.

stage_one.window: December to January, as already fixed for the chain of note 0238
stage_one.work: Large amounts of observational material computed, aggregated and distributed; then continuous observation and learning of the evolution of the small perturbations, growing with each launch into a larger learning and regulation network.
invariants: the overall topology is not broken
learning is continuous from the first stage

acceptance: Every acceptance assertion is exact; no floating-point value appears in any acceptance test or in the retained payload. The run reports each shared item once, with its derived status separated from the declarations it rests on, the pairing rules enforced against at least one deliberately mis-paired control, the corrected usable fraction, the symmetry constraints, the work-region and work-time calculus, the ablation-level assignment, and each declared obligation with its falsifiable counterpart, together with proposal-only bookkeeping.
residual: This is a proposal and a shared basis, not an authorization, a decision or a deployment
Every constant and every symmetry choice is declared; a different declaration is a different run
The termination problem, the governance question and any safety analysis beyond declared obligations remain Unaddressed
